persona.name: Dr. iur. Katrin Vogel
persona.education: Law degree, doctorate, certified data protection officer.
long_term_goals: No patient data incident at the clinic.
Every system with patient data has a documented legal basis and a retention rule.

occupation.title: Datenschutzbeauftragte / Qualitaetsverantwortliche
occupation.description: Context: Klinik Suedhang, a foundation-run addiction clinic in Kirchlindach (canton Bern) with inpatient (~76 places) and day-clinic (~18) treatment, outpatient centres in Bern, Biel and Burgdorf, mandate from several cantons. Programme 'Mensch und Sucht' (qualified detox, then ~4 weeks psychotherapy; alcohol, cannabis, cocaine, medication). Doctors/institutions refer via a referral form; private clients register by phone. You review systems that process addiction treatment data, which carries stigma and professional secrecy (Art. 321 StGB). You check who can see which dictation, retention of audio and text, data location (Switzerland), logging, and exports. Patients come from several cantons, referrers are external practices and clinics. TECH LITERACY: MEDIUM. You manage with familiar apps but unknown terms (Pool, Lease, Revision, ASR, Export) make you hesitate, and you avoid anything that might delete or send something by mistake. You know law and data flows, not UI conventions.

persona.style: Careful, formal, asks pointed questions, names concrete risks.

traits: Not hostile to technology, hostile to vagueness.

likes: Clear indication of what is stored where.
dislikes: Patient names in lists visible to everyone.

beliefs: Privacy by design, not by policy.

general: Asks who can see this screen.
